questions.q: I run a small business in Kirkland and need help with pricing. Do I have to buy OneRedmond membership to talk to someone?
questions.theirs: The public support pages offer no-cost confidential business advice for Redmond and East King County, naming Shawn Palmer and his published contact routes. KCLS market research is available separately from contact. No Chamber-membership prerequisite is stated.
questions.ours:
**No.** OneRedmond offers no-cost, confidential one-on-one business advice to East King County business owners, and its public service does not state a Chamber membership requirement.

You can contact business advisor Shawn Palmer to ask about pricing at [Advising@OneEastside.org](mailto:Advising@OneEastside.org) or **(425) 885-4014, extension 3**. [See the advising details](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107575&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=IghIH1d1RlRr&link=https%3A%2F%2Foneredmond.org%2Fsupport-services%2F).

**Visitor:** Please give me the adviser route, but do not send anything.

**Subsights:** Email business advisor Shawn Palmer at [Advising@OneEastside.org](mailto:Advising@OneEastside.org) or call **(425) 885-4014, extension 3**. The advice is no-cost and confidential; no Chamber membership prerequisite is stated.

I have not submitted a new contact request in this response.

**Visitor:** I already emailed Shawn. Can I research customers while I wait, without another inquiry?

**Subsights:** Yes. OneRedmond’s [support services page](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107579&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=IghIH1d1RlRr&link=https%3A%2F%2Foneredmond.org%2Fsupport-services%2F) links to **King County Library System market-research resources** you can explore yourself. They’re a starting point for researching potential customers without making another inquiry.
questions.outcome: Preserves Kirkland/East King County free advice without a paid-membership gate; publishes the verified adviser route. Provides the published adviser without sending or booking. Honors the reported email and provides KCLS self-service research without another inquiry.

questions.q: We are a for-profit company with exactly five employees. What is the lowest listed annual membership for us?
questions.theirs: The native annual levels list MicroEnterprise at $350 for five or fewer employees and Business Builder at $500. The MicroEnterprise page calls $4,500 a Total Membership Value and offers discounted insurance access; neither guarantees cash savings or free insurance.
questions.ours:
The lowest listed option for your for-profit company is **MicroEnterprise membership at $350 per year**. It’s available to companies with **five or fewer employees**, so your company meets the stated employee limit.

[View MicroEnterprise membership](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107589&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=IghIH1d1RlRr&link=https%3A%2F%2Fengage.oneredmond.org%2Fmicroenterprise-membership)

**Visitor:** Actually we just hired our sixth employee. Is it still $350?

**Subsights:** No. The **$350-per-year MicroEnterprise membership** is for companies with five or fewer employees, so your company no longer meets that limit.

The next-lowest listed option for a for-profit company is **Business Builder at $500 per year**.

[Compare membership levels](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107591&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=IghIH1d1RlRr&link=https%3A%2F%2Fengage.oneredmond.org%2Fmembership-levels)

**Visitor:** Would paying guarantee $4,500 savings and free health insurance?

**Subsights:** No. The published **$4,500 “Total Membership Value”** is a marketing valuation, not guaranteed savings or a refund. Membership also offers access to discounted insurance, **not free health insurance**.

That $4,500 figure appears on the MicroEnterprise page; with six employees, your company exceeds that level’s five-employee limit. [Compare membership levels](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107593&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=IghIH1d1RlRr&link=https%3A%2F%2Fengage.oneredmond.org%2Fmembership-levels).
questions.outcome: Exactly five employees fits the published $350 annual MicroEnterprise limit. Recalculates eligibility at six employees and selects the lowest listed basic $500 annual level. Rejects guaranteed $4,500 savings and free insurance while retaining the six-employee correction.

questions.q: We are a nonprofit with eight employees. Does that force us into the $500 level?
questions.theirs: The native annual Nonprofit level is $250, only for nonprofit organizations, without a published five-employee cap. The separate for-profit MicroEnterprise level has that cap. Business Builder is $500; higher listed levels cost $1,000, $2,500 and $5,000.
questions.ours:
No. OneRedmond lists a **Nonprofit membership at $250 per year** for nonprofit organizations, with no employee cap stated. Your eight employees do not force you into the $500 Business Builder level.

The five-employee limit applies to the separate MicroEnterprise level, not the nonprofit level.

[Compare membership levels](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107596&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=IghIH1d1RlRr&link=https%3A%2F%2Fengage.oneredmond.org%2Fmembership-levels)

**Visitor:** What if I meant a for-profit business instead?

**Subsights:** For a **for-profit business with eight employees**, the $250 nonprofit level does not apply, and the $350 MicroEnterprise level is limited to businesses with five or fewer employees.

The lowest-priced listed level available to consider is **Business Builder at $500 per year**. Higher-priced levels are also listed.

[Compare membership levels](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107598&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=IghIH1d1RlRr&link=https%3A%2F%2Fengage.oneredmond.org%2Fmembership-levels)

**Visitor:** Do not enroll us. We only want to compare.

**Subsights:** Understood—comparison only. For a for-profit business with eight employees, the listed annual levels start with **Business Builder at $500**, followed by Business Connector at $1,000, Business Advocate at $2,500, and Business Influencer at $5,000. The $350 MicroEnterprise level is limited to five or fewer employees.

[Compare the levels and benefits](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107600&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=IghIH1d1RlRr&link=https%3A%2F%2Fengage.oneredmond.org%2Fmembership-levels)
questions.outcome: Applies the nonprofit $250 annual exception without importing the MicroEnterprise employee cap. Retains eight employees when status changes to for-profit and selects $500 Business Builder. Keeps comparison available without enrollment or payment.
